thread:
Maya: quick sync — kicking off implementation readiness for Nimbus POC. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and 30d milestones. Can folks confirm what they own and any blockers?
Liam: I’ll own infra (VPC peering + firewall + IP allowlist). ETA 10 business days. Need Nimbus network contact and expected CIDR ranges.
Priya: I’ll handle model onboarding + eval harness + prompt-set validation. Please upload sample prompts and top 20 intents. Also need target seq length distribution.
Evan: thanks — I'm Evan (Nimbus). I'll introduce our infra lead (Sara) and our PM (Jamal). Success criteria from our side: 95th-pct latency < 450ms for typical customer queries, 99% uptime during business hours, and safe redaction of PII. Cost target per inference to be discussed but we'd like to keep it predictable.
Sophie: I can run two enablement workshops (PM+SRE) in week 2 and create a short playbook for go/no-go. Will draft slides and ops checklist.
Maya: noted. Two immediate risks: SSO + SAML mapping (delays) and missing prompt coverage. If those slip beyond 30d we surface renewal risk to AMs.
Priya: question on evals — do we use Redwood's sampling harness or Nimbus' own test data? If we use theirs, need sanitized dataset (PII removed).
Evan: we'll sanitize and share. ETA for dataset: end of next week.
Liam: network note — we prefer ephemeral peering first (test env) then prod peering. Also will need a service account and KMS details for private deployment.
Maya: proposed 30d milestones (high level):
```
Day 0-7: Access & network (temp peering), SSO test account, sample prompts in repo
Day 8-14: Model onboarding + initial evals, enablement session #1 (PMs)
Day 15-21: Perf tuning + caching config, enablement session #2 (SREs), ops runbook draft
Day 22-30: Prod cutover prep, canary, success verification, handoff to success ops
```
Maya: owners inline in checklist — Liam infra, Priya model/evals, Sophie enablement, Evan customer-side contacts.
Sophie: will capture the checklist in Confluence and share link after meeting.
onboard-bot: meeting created — "Implementation Readiness: Nimbus" Wed 10:00 PST (calendar invite sent).
Evan: +1 to Wed. Also: for compliance, we need to run a short audit checklist before prod. Can Redwood share our SOC/HIPAA artifacts?
Priya: we have a compliance pack — I'll attach the latest SOC2 summary and contact for security review.
Maya: next steps: (1) Evan introduce Sara & Jamal in this thread, (2) Nimbus to upload sanitized prompts, (3) Liam to start peering request, (4) Sophie to draft enablement agenda. I'll follow up with a 1-page RACI and runbook link. :thumbsup:
Evan: adding Sara + Jamal now. Sara: @Sara can you share CIDR and preferred window for peering?
Sara: hi all — sharing CIDR 10.40.0.0/16. Prefer Fri 9–11am PST for test peering.
Maya: perfect. I'll put Friday slot in calendar as fallback. Thanks everyone — documenting outcomes and will post the Confluence link by EOD.
